strings.banner.must_confirm: Please check this medicine against your document or label before using it.
strings.banner.safety.confirm_first: Some medicine details need your confirmation first, so the interaction results below may be incomplete. Please confirm them with your doctor or pharmacist.
strings.banner.safety.review_interactions: One or more possible interactions were found. Please talk to your doctor or pharmacist about them.
strings.confirm.action.not_in_list: My medicine is not in the list
strings.confirm.action.remove: Remove: this is not on my document
strings.confirm.action.select_formulary_drug: Choose the right medicine from the list

strings.confirm.flag.conflicting_frequency: The text gives more than one way to take this medicine. I have checked it with my document.

strings.confirm.flag.not_identifiable: We could not identify this medicine, so it was not checked for interactions.

strings.confirm.you_added: You added this medicine from the list.
strings.confirm.you_selected: You chose this medicine from the list.
strings.consent.item.delete: You can delete everything now with one button. This also withdraws your consent.
strings.consent.item.how_long: Saved results are kept until you delete them or 24 hours pass, whichever comes first.
strings.consent.item.interaction_limited: The interaction information is limited. It was drafted from official drug labels by the project author and has not been reviewed by a pharmacist.
strings.consent.item.no_sharing: We do not sell or share your data.
strings.consent.item.prototype: This is a class project prototype. It is not medical advice. Always confirm with your doctor or pharmacist.
strings.consent.item.stored: We keep the results, not the photo, unless you choose to keep the photo. Everything we keep is encrypted.
strings.consent.item.translation_draft: The Tamil and Hindi texts are machine-drafted and have not been reviewed by native speakers.
strings.consent.item.what: CareBridge reads a photo of your medical document and explains it in simple words.
strings.consent.item.where: The photo is read on this computer by a local model. Nothing is sent to any outside service.
strings.consent.purpose.keep_photo_for_session: Also keep the photo for this session (optional)
strings.consent.purpose.process_photo: Read the photo of my document (required)
strings.consent.purpose.store_results_for_sessio: Save the results for this session (required)
strings.consent.title: Before we start
strings.delete.confirm: Delete everything now? This removes your session, results and any kept photo. It cannot be undone.
strings.delete.done: Your data has been deleted and your consent is withdrawn.
strings.error.consent_invalid: The consent could not be saved. Please accept the required items and try again.
strings.error.consent_required: Please read and accept the notice before continuing.
strings.error.image_invalid: This image could not be opened or is too large in pixels. Please try another photo.
strings.error.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
strings.error.invalid_confirmation: Some of your choices could not be used. Please check them and try again.
strings.error.invalid_request: The request was not valid. Please check it and try again.
strings.error.no_session: No active session. Please start again.
strings.error.not_ready: This is not ready yet. Please wait for the reading to finish.
strings.error.pdf_not_supported: Please upload a photo or image (PNG or JPG). PDF is not supported yet.
strings.error.queue_full: The reader is busy. Please try again in a minute.
strings.error.request_blocked: This request was blocked for security reasons.
strings.error.retry_unavailable: The photo was not kept, so it has to be uploaded again.
strings.error.session_expired: Your session has expired and the data was removed. Please start again.
strings.error.too_many_documents: The limit of documents for this session has been reached. Delete your data to start again.
strings.error.unsupported_file: Please upload a photo or image (PNG or JPG).
strings.error.upload_too_large: This file is too large. Please use a smaller photo.
strings.job.failed.context_truncated: This document is too long to read in one go. Please upload one page at a time.
strings.job.failed.image_not_received: The reader did not receive the photo. Please upload it again.
strings.job.failed.image_unreadable: We could not read this photo. Please try a clearer photo.
strings.job.failed.interrupted: Reading was interrupted when the app restarted. Please upload again.
strings.job.failed.ollama_unavailable: The local reader is not running. Please start it and upload again.
strings.job.failed.provider_not_allowed: This app is set to read photos with an outside service, which is not allowed for your photos. Nothing was sent.
strings.job.failed.timeout: Reading took too long. Please try again.
strings.label.draft_unreviewed: Draft translation, not yet checked by a native speaker.
strings.label.machine_checked: Automatic translation checked by software only, not by a native speaker.
strings.label.machine_checked_en: Automatic rewording checked by software only.
strings.notice.ambiguous_OD: "OD" can mean once a day, or it can mean something else, such as the right eye. Please check with your doctor or pharmacist.
strings.notice.incomplete_quote: Some of the text for this medicine may be missing or unclear. Please check it against your document.
strings.notice.near_miss_name: This name is close to, but not exactly the same as, a known medicine name. Please check the spelling against your document.
strings.notice.non_daily_frequency: This medicine may not be taken every day. Please confirm the schedule.
strings.notice.unresolved_name: This medicine name was not found in our list. Please check the name against your document.
strings.notice.unusual_strength: This strength is not one we usually see for this medicine. Please check it against your document.
strings.picker.compare_note: Compare the brand name, generic name and strength with your document before you choose.
strings.picker.no_results: No medicine found in the list.
strings.picker.search: Search medicine by brand or generic name
strings.schedule.no_meal_timing: No meal timing was found in the document, so these times are spread through the day.
strings.schedule.not.as_needed: Not scheduled: this medicine is only taken when needed.
strings.schedule.not.no_identity: Not scheduled: we could not identify this medicine.
strings.schedule.not.non_daily: Not scheduled: this medicine is not taken every day. Follow your document.
strings.schedule.not.not_confirmed: Not scheduled: please confirm this medicine first.
strings.schedule.not.too_many_doses: Not scheduled automatically: please set your own times for this medicine.
strings.schedule.notice: Suggested times only; adjust them to match your doctor's instructions.
strings.status.narrative_preparing: Still preparing this explanation. Please check again in a moment.
strings.summary.disclaimer: This summary lists what was read from your document and what you entered. It may contain mistakes. It is not medical advice. Your doctor decides about your treatment.

strings.timing.unspecified: No meal timing was found in the document. Please check the label or ask a pharmacist.
